description: Building on past discoveries, exploring new frontiers.
summary: Team Fortunas developed a 3-minute educational video exploring NASA's lost hardware on the Moon and Mars, using NASA's Open Data and DaVinci Resolve. Our project addresses the challenge by transforming scientific information into an engaging visual story that highlights the forgotten objects of space exploration. Its goal is to make space knowledge accessible to curious minds of all ages and inspire greater interest in space exploration.
details:
Hello everyone! So, we're Domipinks and Sanae, representing Team Fortunas!

Our mission is to uncover a fascinating yet often overlooked part of space exploration: NASA's lost hardware on the Moon and Mars.

From spacecraft that made historic journeys to equipment left behind on distant worlds, these objects hold stories of human curiosity, ambition, and discovery.

To share these stories, we've created a 3-minute video using DaVinci Resolve and NASA's Open Data, making space exploration accessible, engaging, and educational for curious minds of all ages.

Because even the things we leave behind have stories worth telling!

We're Team Fortunas.

Thank you!
